narr: An upper level disturbance along the Middle Texas coast interacted with deep tropical moisture to produce thunderstorms with locally heavy rainfall over the Coastal Bend in the afternoon. Flooding of roads occurred near Rockport and in Corpus Christi.
ev: The northwest loop ramp to southbound State Highway 286 was closed due to flooding.
The Nueces Bay Boulevard exit on Martin Luther King Drive was closed due to flooding.
Water was over the road on Seaside Loop and various other low lying roads north of Lamar.
